summary: A correction to RFC 404, which had given the wrong number for the ISI IMP. The note says the address is 22, not 86, and repeats the complete corrected text of RFC 404.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC corrects one address in RFC 404. It says the ISI IMP address is 22 decimal, while the ISI TENEX network address remains 86.

subtitle: A correction to the IMP address given in RFC 404.

tldr.problem: RFC 404 contained a typographic error in the stated address of the ISI IMP.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 405 corrects the IMP address to 22 decimal and repeats the corrected text of RFC 404.
tldr.outcome: It says all other numbers in RFC 404 were correct. The unit metadata says RFC 405 updates RFC 404.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 405 as Unknown and says it updates RFC 404. It is a historical address correction.

sections.title: Correcting the IMP Address
sections.content: RFC 405 corrects a typographic error in RFC 404. The address of the ISI IMP is 22 decimal, not 86 as the earlier RFC stated. The note says all other numbers in RFC 404 were correct.
sections.plainLanguage: The earlier note gave the wrong number for the ISI IMP. This RFC corrects it to 22 decimal.

sections.title: The Corrected Network Details
sections.content:
The RAND IMP was temporarily removed from the network and a new IMP installed at ISI. Some people and computers moved from RAND to ISI; the RAND TENEX became the ISI TENEX.

The ISI IMP address is 22 decimal, and the TENEX at ISI is Host number one, giving the ISI TENEX Network Address as 86. The RAND IMP was expected to return as IMP number 7, and RAND's IBM 360/65 would retain Network Address 7.
sections.plainLanguage: The IMP number and the host's network address are different values. The correction changes the ISI IMP address but keeps the ISI TENEX network address at 86.

sections.title: What Remains Unchanged
sections.content: The correction concerns the ISI IMP's address only. The RFC states that the other numbers in RFC 404 were correct, including the ISI TENEX Network Address 86 and RAND's address 7.
sections.plainLanguage: Only the IMP address was wrong. The other values in RFC 404 remain as stated.

references.text: RFC 404, whose ISI IMP address is corrected.
